title: Report
summary: Reports a chat or one message to the Bipe team with a reason the person writes, and optionally leaves the chat. Moderation under end-to-end encryption is report-based: the team sees only the reason and what the person chooses to send.

target.description: chat: from the profile or the chat info. message: from message-actions.

alsoLeave.description: Chat target: leave (or delete, for a DM) after the report.

phase.description: leaveFailed: the report went but the leave did not.

send.effect: chat: Room.reportRoom with the reason. message: Room.reportContent with the event ID and the reason. Then, with alsoLeave, Room.leave (a DM uses Apagar conversa, parity dm-delete). Off while reason is blank.

notes: The report goes to the homeserver admins (Matrix spec reporting endpoints); Bipe staff read it there. No message text is attached by the app.
A message from a scam warning row (message-scam-warning) can be reported the same way.
Reporting a person without a chat is not possible in Matrix phase 1; the profile's report uses the DM when one exists, else it is hidden.
